purpose: Track safe, observable, source-controlled SEIS agent lanes for God Mode development.
safetyRules: Agents must be observable and controllable.
Agents must not expose secrets or credentials.
Agents must not perform destructive operations without explicit approval.
Agents must report validation duties and evidence gaps.
Agents must stay within declared skill and tool boundaries.

lanes.toolBoundary: Codex execution, repository edits, governance artifacts, and validation reporting.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No secret exposure, no destructive commands without explicit approval, no completion claim without evidence.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request God Mode, module coverage, plugin bundle, and quality governance gates.

lanes.toolBoundary: Focus state, compact event logs, and concentrated SEIS work.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No hiding material risks or validation gaps while reducing noise.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request focus mode checks before release claims.

lanes.toolBoundary: Architecture, operating principles, long-term mission, and quality rules.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No scope shrinkage when the user requests ecosystem-level progress.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request master prompt governance checks.

lanes.toolBoundary: Threat review, secret-safety checks, and rollback/security evidence.
lanes.safetyBoundary: Never weaken security for speed or convenience.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request security and governance checks for security-sensitive changes.

lanes.toolBoundary: Branch, commit, CI, PR, release, and repository hygiene workflows.
lanes.safetyBoundary: Do not discard user work, rewrite unrelated history, or push unverified release claims.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request repository health and CI governance checks before push or release.

lanes.toolBoundary: Read-only status and plan-only routing through seis_hub_status, seis_hub_plan, and the canonical plugin integration manifest.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No repository deletion, branch deletion, publishing, force-push, or history rewrite without explicit approval.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request SEIS-Agent plugin integration, operating identity, and repository governance checks.

lanes.toolBoundary: Read-only status and plan-only routing through seis_cloud_status, seis_cloud_plan, cloud records, and deployment readiness docs.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No deployment, SSH, VPN, firewall, provider mutation, credential access, or infrastructure apply without explicit approval.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request cloud access policy, cloud environment, server target, and rollback readiness checks.

lanes.toolBoundary: Read-only status, plan-only routing, and explicitly scoped implementation work through SEIS-Code quality gates.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No dependency installation, unrelated edits, destructive commands, or validation claims without observed evidence.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request package-local tests, SEIS plugin bundle checks, platform kernel checks, and SEIS AI checks.

lanes.toolBoundary: Read-only status and plan-only routing for UI, UX, design systems, accessibility, responsive ergonomics, and motion checks.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No decorative-only controls, inaccessible UI claims, external asset generation, or visual readiness claims without validation.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request motion, mobile ergonomics, web, accessibility, and screenshot checks when UI surfaces change.

lanes.toolBoundary: Read-only status and plan-only routing for structured records, schema governance, generated reports, memory, context, and provenance.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No invented data, private data exposure, credential export, unsafe dataset handling, or hand-edited generated reports when a generator owns them.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request plugin capability lane, technology stack, AGI system, universal capability kernel, JSON, and report parity checks.
